The year '''1052 BBY before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] (BBY)''' was a span of [[Time/Legends|time]] that occurred during the [[New Sith Wars]].

==Events==
*The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Mandragall]] is seduced by the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Xelian]], who subsequently [[Death/Legends|murders]] him.<ref name="MandragallDeathDate">Page 170 of the novel [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']] mentions that Mandragall was killed twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of the book. As the [[StarWars.com]] article [http://www.starwars.com/vault/books/knight_errant_lego/index.html Engineering with LEGOs: Creating the Ships of ''Knight Errant''] states that ''Knight Errant'' is set in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], this places Mandragall's death in 1052 BBY.</ref>
